title: What is the Best Interval to Screen Women 45-49 and 70-74 for Breast Cancer?
official: What is the Best Interval to Screen Women 45-49 and 70-74 for Breast Cancer
summary: Italian, multicenter, study aimed at defining the best interval for screening women 45-49 and 70-74 years for Breast Cancer (BC). This research project includes (1) a controlled, prospective randomized non-inferiority trial to determine the optimal screening interval for women aged 45-49, with and without high mammographic density, (2) a retrospective data collection, with the same purpose, on screening performed by women aged 70-74, and (3) a qualitative research to define the best communication strategy.

interventions.name: screening for breast cancer with tomosynthesis and synthetic 2D mammography performed at different interval compared to actual clinical practice
